New Features

* Overview: Added GPU status views and vLLM token throughput monitoring by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14251、https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14325 * Overview: Added support for multiple directory shortcuts by @xiaomeinvG in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14132 * Models: Completely rebuilt GPU management by @ssongliu、@wanghe-fit2cloud in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14322、https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14348 * Models: Completely rebuilt vLLM management by @ssongliu、@wanghe-fit2cloud * Models: Completely rebuilt model services by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14306、https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14282、https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14317 * Agents: Added support for DeepSeek Harness and OctoP by @zhengkunwang223 in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14138 * MCP Management: Added 1Panel MCP service management by @lan-yonghui in Containers: Added support for batch file uploads to container directories by @xiaomeinvG in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14133 * Containers: Added container image update detection and
